title: The Agents Themselves — Stripboard
description:
The other half of the Grafana track: observe the agent you build (EV-47).

Separate from 'Shoot Mission Control' on purpose. That dashboard answers 'how is the production doing'; this one answers 'how is the software doing', and putting the two on one screen makes neither question easy to ask.

NOTE ON SERIES NAMES: these are the Prometheus forms of the OTLP instruments in agents/common/telemetry.py — dots become underscores and counters gain _total. If a panel reads No data after the agents have run, confirm the exact names with the MCP tool list_prometheus_metric_names against regex 'agent.*' rather than guessing; an empty panel and a wrong query look identical.

panels.title: 🎟️ Tokens spent
panels.description: Every Gemini token these agents have consumed. 'Ask your shoot' runs several rounds per question, so this grows in steps rather than smoothly.

panels.title: 🔌 MCP calls
panels.description: Every tools/call the agents have made, to Grafana and to our own servers. This is the partner integration counted from the inside.

panels.title: ❌ MCP calls that failed
panels.description: Counted separately because a counter that only increments on success reports a healthy integration right up until nothing works.

panels.title: 💬 Tokens per question, over time
panels.description: A question that quietly takes six rounds costs six times one that takes one. Without this the only signal is the bill at the end of the month.

panels.title: ⏱️ Where the twenty seconds go
panels.description: Model time and tool time on the same axis. 'The model is slow' and 'Grafana is slow' need different fixes, and one number cannot tell them apart.

panels.title: 🔧 Which MCP tools, how often
panels.description: Not 'we use MCP' but which tools the agents actually reach for. The shape of this is the integration's real surface area.

panels.title: 🐢 How long the far end takes
panels.description: p95 of a tools/call, by server. Grafana Cloud and our own Cloud Run services answer at very different speeds, and both are on this line.

panels.title: 📊 Calls by outcome
panels.description: ok against error. A rising error line here is the first thing that would tell you the sentinel has stopped being able to read alerts.
